name: Tofu with Cauliflower Rice, Spinach, Tomatoes & Creamy Basil Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
1 small pkg fresh basil
3 (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Cut each cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a large bowl.
Add oil and spices to the bowl with the cauliflower, then stir to combine. Transfer cauliflower rice to another large baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Large dice tofu. Return to the baking sheet used for pressing; drizzle with oil, season with spices, then toss to coat. Spread tofu out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 tbsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring both halfway through, until cauliflower is tender and tofu is golden, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add additional oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tomatoes and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until tomatoes start to burst, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the tomatoes are cooking, finely grate Parmesan.

Add Parmesan, broth, cream, and garlic powder to the skillet; stir to combine the sauce and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened, 7-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) heavy whipping cream
2 ½ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the sauce is done, add basil and spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice, tofu, and sauce between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
